title: WoodCraft+
description: Craft chests and sticks from any type of log, making wood-based crafting faster and easier while staying fully vanilla-friendly.
body:
WoodcraftPlus – Easier Wood Recipes

WoodcraftPlus is a simple and vanilla-friendly Minecraft datapack that makes crafting wood-based items faster and more convenient. With this datapack, you can craft chests and sticks from any type of log, including all overworld and Nether wood variants such as oak, spruce, birch, jungle, acacia, dark oak, mangrove, cherry, pale oak, crimson, and warped.

No more tedious crafting with individual planks or small batches. You can now convert 8 logs into 4 chests or 2 logs into 16 sticks, saving resources and time while building. This is especially useful for large-scale construction projects, survival playthroughs, or when working with multiple wood types in creative designs.

WoodcraftPlus works fully within Minecraft’s vanilla mechanics, keeping the game balanced while expanding your crafting options. It is perfect for players who want to streamline their gameplay without adding overly complex mechanics or breaking immersion.

Install the datapack, place your logs in the crafting table, and enjoy quicker, more efficient wood crafting. Whether you are exploring the Overworld forests or collecting stems in the Nether, WoodcraftPlus ensures that every log has a purpose and helps make your building and survival experience smoother and more enjoyable.
